text_blocks.snippet: "Conditions and diseases" is a broad term encompassing a wide range of health issues, from common ailments to severe illnesses. It includes both acute and chronic conditions, and encompasses infectious diseases, chronic diseases, and mental health conditions. Examples include heart disease, cancer, diabetes, arthritis, and infectious diseases like influenza or COVID-19.
